notes: Verified with numeric_tolerance rather than sympy_equiv so that the family runs in both implementations. A symbolic variant would swap the verifier for sympy_equiv and become Python-only. abs_tol is 1e-4 because the prompt asks for four decimal places, so the worst honest rounding error is 5e-5.
